description: PAINTED IDENTITY DIFFERS - true identity is US Navy F-4B-15-MC BuNo 151021; briefly loaned to the USAF as 62-12196 with the 4453rd CCTW; flew with VF-14 and VF-101 and was struck off charge at NAS Oceana 13 Oct 1971; modified to resemble an F-4E for radar and ECM tests at the Newport New York test site from 1972; restored by Mohawk Valley Community College students and mounted on a pedestal over a pond at the Eastern Air Defense Sector 10 Dec 2010 painted as F-4D 66-7456 in 107th FIG / 136th FIS New York ANG colours

A Phantom formerly used on the Rome Air Development Center antenna test pedestal was moved to permanent display at the Eastern Air Defense Sector; directories give 65-0456 while a 2016 photographer's caption gives 66-0456 so the serial is unresolved and tail_number is left blank; the display sits inside a controlled facility
